title: Length can grow while energy falls
summary: A scalar warmup, then an exact rational 2D certificate.

steps.title: Start with one number
steps.caption: For a = 4/5, each step multiplies x by 4/5 and V = x² by 16/25. The certificate requires |a| < 1.

steps.title: The ordinary length can grow
steps.caption: In the 2D example, x₀ = (1, 0) becomes (1, -0.35). Squared length rises from 1 to 449/400. This does not disprove stability.

steps.title: Choose a different energy
steps.caption: SymPy solves P - AᵀPA = I exactly. P is positive definite by its positive leading principal minors. Along this trajectory V loses exactly the previous squared length.

steps.title: Know what carries the conclusion
steps.caption: The existing Lean theorem assumes both quadratic forms are positive and proves convergence. These plots are finite examples. SymPy is checking this certificate's algebra, not re-proving the theorem or validating a robot.
